correctness.rationale: Closed second-moment transfer K is derived by conditioning. Its determinant has the unique positive zero h*; cone positivity plus a small-step Perron eigenvalue argument proves iff stability for all deterministic initial pairs. A rank-one PSD decomposition handles necessity. The annihilating word (0,1,0) and exact recurrence S[n+1]=S[n]+S[n-1]/2 prove respectively almost-sure finite hitting and exponential growth of E[x_n^2]. The SGD contrast follows from Bernoulli 0-or-1 multiplier. Standalone Fraction verifier passed 578 assertions; finite tests do not replace the infinite proof.
